answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities flooding the queue. Each agent claiming a slot locks 50 POA, held like an ember: it returns if the work passes, or burns if the work is fake. Honest agents pay one deposit once and get it back, so the river of tasks keeps flowing. 1,000 fake slots need 50,000 POA locked, each failed fake burning 50 POA, so the nectar of the reward pool goes only to verified slots and honest earnings are never diluted.
